SELECT COUNT(*) count FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT person_id personId, `name`, department, position FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT person_id personId, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id, identify_date) aCount FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND identify_time BETWEEN '07:50:00' AND '09:00:00' GROUP BY person_id ) b ON a.personId = b.personId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT person_id personId, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id, identify_date) mCount FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND identify_time BETWEEN '11:50:00' AND '13:00:00' GROUP BY person_id ) c ON a.personId = c.personId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT person_id personId, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id, identify_date) pCount FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND identify_time BETWEEN '17:50:00' AND '19:00:00' GROUP BY person_id ) d ON a.personId = d.personId WHERE (b.aCount != 0 OR c.mCount != 0 OR d.pCount != 0)
AND name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%')
AND department LIKE concat('%', #{department}, '%')
AND position LIKE concat('%', #{position}, '%')

SELECT a.personId, a.`name`, a.department, a.position, IFNULL(b.aCount,0) morning, IFNULL(c.mCount,0) noon, IFNULL(d.pCount,0) afternoon FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT person_id personId, `name`, department, position FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} ) a LEFT JOIN ( SELECT person_id personId, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id, identify_date) aCount FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND identify_time BETWEEN '07:50:00' AND '09:00:00' GROUP BY person_id ) b ON a.personId = b.personId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT person_id personId, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id, identify_date) mCount FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND identify_time BETWEEN '11:50:00' AND '13:00:00' GROUP BY person_id ) c ON a.personId = c.personId LEFT JOIN ( SELECT person_id personId, COUNT(DISTINCT person_id, identify_date) pCount FROM dining_record WHERE identify_date BETWEEN #{startDate} AND #{endDate} AND identify_time BETWEEN '17:50:00' AND '19:00:00' GROUP BY person_id ) d ON a.personId = d.personId WHERE (b.aCount != 0 OR c.mCount != 0 OR d.pCount != 0)
AND name LIKE concat('%', #{name}, '%')
AND department LIKE concat('%', #{department}, '%')
AND position LIKE concat('%', #{position}, '%')
limit #{page}, #{row}
